title: The Deconvolver decides what is in a sample
set_out: Settle the cross-laboratory question on the 89 outside samples already read, each read as what the Deconvolver finds in it; keep every machine busy; then the Sequencing Atlas Globe page.
open_at_turnover: The label rule's synthetic; the cross-laboratory synthetic over the 89 samples' real range, then the 89 scored per person; the Johns Hopkins tissue test finishing on Google; R12 on every cell, then R10 and R6; the Sequencing Atlas Globe page.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Megakaryocyte versions published
entries.what: IAM Sequencing Atlas version 1.1 and Sequencing Atlas Globe version 1.1 on Zenodo (the author's yes), 58 cells, the 57 unchanged.
entries.outcome: Live: 10.5281/zenodo.24029328 and 10.5281/zenodo.24029332; README, book, glossary, catalogue and site builders updated.

entries.title: What the chain reported on 89 outside samples
entries.what: Every outside-laboratory sequencing sample already read, tabulated from its bundle: the Deconvolver's cells, the library's false-call rate and depth.
entries.outcome: No sorted sample is one cell (the labeled cell 24 to 80 %); false-call rate 0.0016 to 0.0158 against the atlas laboratory's 0.0063.

entries.title: The Deconvolver decides what is in a sample
entries.what: Four places where a label chose the cell removed (three in run_sample.py, one in run_series.py); the label is checked and recorded (label_check); gate rule 23b-h refuses any return; the lesson in the Decoder, the intake code and the workflow.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday
Our own mistakes, and what caught each

entries.title: A label chose the cell, inside the chain
entries.what: From 10-22 to 10-28 the agent added code that took the cell from the specimen's words (the sorted-cell Met-A, IAM-A's cell, a 'sorted X' override of the mix, a sample list's cell column), and the cross-laboratory scorers compared samples by label, against the author's 10-22 rule that the tools decide what is in a sample.
entries.outcome: Caught by the author; removed and refused by the gate (rule 23b-h).

entries.title: GitHub filled to the last slot
entries.what: The R12 every-cell replay was sent on 20 machines with R10 and R6 queued behind it, so the commit gate waited over 30 minutes, a lesson already given on 11-04.
entries.outcome: R10 and R6 cancelled before they started; every dispatch now leaves 2 slots free.
